cleaning.rule: Fail closed on RIC identity collisions by excluding all RICs mapped to >1 PERMNO in the delivered panel.
Use market_value, volatility_60d, and adv_20d as time-t observed policy inputs.
Define realized capacity ratio as 1 + min(0, min-forward cumulative return) at 20/60 sessions.
Evaluate policies on a common complete-case sample for each horizon.

metrics.binding_constraint: for VOL-LIQ-003, the lower of volatility capacity and liquidity capacity
metrics.coverage_rate: share of observations where permitted capacity ratio <= realized downside-only capacity ratio
metrics.mean_permitted_capacity_ratio: average policy-permitted capacity divided by time-t market value

policy_definitions.claim: Reference baseline only; not a market standard or optimized rule.
policy_definitions.name: Fixed 20% haircut

policy_definitions.claim: Predeclared research rule; not fitted to maximize historical coverage.
policy_definitions.name: Volatility-adaptive haircut

policy_definitions.claim: Predeclared research rule exposing a binding-constraint comparison; not fitted to maximize historical coverage.
policy_definitions.formula: permitted_ratio = min(volatility_capacity, liquidity_capacity); liquidity_capacity = clip(0.50 + 50 * (adv_20d / market_value), 0.60, 0.95)
policy_definitions.name: Volatility + liquidity guard

reproduction_boundary: Exact raw-row reproduction requires the licensed source package. Public artifacts reproduce aggregate policy outputs and disclose formulas, sample rules, hashes, and counts.

source_methods_disclosure.esg: Not used in empirical policy evaluation because delivered coverage is insufficient.
source_methods_disclosure.market_evidence: CRSP daily market fields with Refinitiv .SPX-derived universe construction; source package methods retained privately.
